int_name: E ALLEGHENY AVE & N FRONT ST

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with traffic signals and sidewalks but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian-specific signal heads. The wide, unmarked pavement and presence of vehicles parked close to the corner create a challenging environment for pedestrians to cross safely.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection, there are no painted crosswalks to guide pedestrians or alert drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A truck parked near the corner on the right side of the image may block the view between pedestrians and approaching or turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The lack of clear lane lines and stop bars can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning at the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a commercial urban corridor with wide travel lanes and marked zebra crosswalks at a signalized intersection. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and parked vehicles near the intersection create visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on both sides of the street obstruct the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both the left and right sides of the street near the foreground crosswalk.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are showing signs of wear and fading, which reduces their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps, but lacks visible dedicated pedestrian signals and physical traffic calming measures. The presence of parked cars near the crossing and the wide street width for a one-way road may increase risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles near crosswalk
hazards.description: Parked cars on the left side of the image are very close to the crosswalk, potentially obstructing sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed turns from the cross-street, increasing risk at the crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install visible pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide better information to crossing pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide one-way urban street with a marked continental crosswalk and overhead traffic signals. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the multi-lane configuration and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or refuge islands increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway.
